component.name: Unsplash Wallpaper Applet
component.summary: Fetch and configure desktop wallpapers from Unsplash for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: A panel applet for the System76 COSMIC desktop environment that fetches high-resolution wallpapers from the Unsplash API and applies them directly to cosmic-bg.

Features include configurable Unsplash API credentials, search queries, topic and collection filters, photographer filtering, orientation and safety filters, resolution selection, scaling modes, and automatic rotation intervals.
